title: Module quiz: Scenario: multi-agent research system

questions.stem: Scenario S3, a multi-agent research system in which a coordinator delegates to specialised subagents. A run ends with three of four scopes covered, one unresolved error and one conflict between two sources. Which status does the report carry?

options.text: Complete, since a conflict is information and the scopes were mostly covered anyway
options.says: Ruled out because completeness is about coverage: "A run is complete when every scope is covered."

options.text: Partial, since one topic is missing, and the disagreement is listed beside it
options.says: A missing scope makes the run partial, and a conflict is reported next to it.

options.text: Complete, since the unresolved error was only a timeout and nothing was lost
options.says: Ruled out because the reason for a gap does not matter: "It is partial otherwise, whatever the reason, and the report says which scopes are missing and why."

options.text: Failed, because an unresolved error invalidates the whole report
options.says: Ruled out because the report is still useful: "A report that did not cover film is still a useful report".

questions.stem: Scenario S3, a multi-agent research system in which a coordinator delegates to specialised subagents. The synthesis agent's verification tool is asked to confirm a market-share figure that it cannot check locally. What should it return?

options.text: A verdict that a lookup is needed, which the hub routes onward
options.says: Anything the tool cannot check goes back to be delegated.

options.text: A confirmation, since the tool must leave no claim unchecked
options.says: Ruled out because a deep check stays where it was: "leaves the deep verification where it was: with the coordinator".

options.text: An error that ends the synthesis step for the whole run
options.says: Ruled out because the tool exists to remove the round trip for the common case: "A scoped tool of this kind removes the round trip for the common case".

options.text: A guess at the figure based on the other claims in the report
options.says: Ruled out because the tool does not guess: "In the example, the tool answers for a date it can check, and returns `needs_search` for anything else."

questions.stem: Scenario S3, a multi-agent research system in which a coordinator delegates to specialised subagents. A report's note lists `music (not researched)` beside `film (timeout on a query)`. What does the note tell the reader about music?

options.text: No subtask of the plan named it, so the fault is in the decomposition
options.says: A scope that no result names was never planned: "A scope that no result names was never researched, which is the decomposition fault of page 1 and is fixed in the plan."

options.text: Its search failed on a fault of the tool, with the query recorded
options.says: Ruled out because that is the phrasing for a failed search: "A scope whose search failed names the type and the query."

options.text: A source was searched and had nothing to say about it
options.says: Ruled out because that is the third phrasing: "A scope with a result but no findings has no findings."

options.text: A conflict between two sources left the topic incomplete
options.says: Ruled out because a conflict is not a gap: "A conflict does not change the status, because it is information the reader needs and not a missing piece."

questions.stem: Scenario S3, a multi-agent research system in which a coordinator delegates to specialised subagents. A claim rests on two findings: one that arrived before a subagent failed and one from a subagent that finished. Both agree. How is the claim flagged?

options.text: As incomplete, because one of its findings arrived from a run that failed
options.says: Ruled out because the flag needs every finding to be partial: "A claim is marked partial only when every finding behind it was partial".

options.text: As conflicting, since the two findings came from two different runs
options.says: Ruled out because the findings agree: "A conflict is two different values for one claim, not two sources for the same value".

options.text: Without the incomplete mark, because a completed run backs it as well
options.says: One finished source is enough to remove the flag.

options.text: As missing, because partial evidence cannot support a claim
options.says: Ruled out because partial findings stay as claims: "Partial findings stay in the claims, flagged, so a reader can use them and can see that they are incomplete."

origin.section: Partial is information and it is not coverage
